fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `/manabase` form called `parse_and_validate_decklist(check_legality=False)`, meaning it accepted cards that are not legal in Penny Dreadful. Users could enter banned/rotated cards and get a manabase recommendation for an illegal deck.

## What changed

- **`magic/legality.py`**: Added `skip_size_checks: bool = False` parameter to `legal_formats()`. When `True`, the <60-card and >15-sideboard size checks are skipped, but all card-level legality checks (banned, not legal, restricted, too many copies) still apply.
- **`decksite/form.py`**: Added `check_only_card_legality()` method on `DecklistForm`. It calls `legal_formats(…, skip_size_checks=True)` so it validates each card's Penny Dreadful legality and bug status without requiring a full 60-card deck.
- **`decksite/manabase.py`**: `ManabaseForm.do_validation()` now calls `check_only_card_legality()` after parsing the decklist, so illegal or buggy cards are flagged to the user.
- **`magic/legality_test.py`**: Added `test_legal_formats_skip_size_checks` covering the new parameter.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 846 passed, 1 skipped (full suite, including new test)

Fixes #12444
